description: This file contains the main activity implementation for a Tic-Tac-Toe game on Android, handling game state, UI updates, and user interactions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity managing the UI and logic for a Tic-Tac-Toe game on Android.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game state and UI to start a new game.

methods.name: onCellTapped
methods.description: Handles user tapping on a game cell; updates state, checks for win/draw, and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: lockBoard
methods.description: Disables further cell interactions once the game concludes.

methods.name: findWinner
methods.description: Checks current board state for a winner based on win lines.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Determines if the game ended in a draw.

methods.name: updatePlayerIndicator
methods.description: Updates the display showing which player's turn it is.

methods.name: setBannerNeutral
methods.description: Sets a neutral message on the result banner.

methods.name: setBannerWin
methods.description: Displays a winning message on the result banner.

methods.name: setBannerDraw
methods.description: Displays a draw message on the result banner.

methods.name: applyMarkStyling
methods.description: Applies visual styling to a cell after a move, including accessibility descriptions.
